cases.rationale: Qb8 retreats the queen away from the e6 rook and permits Qe2–Qe5 to take over the centre. A much later Ne6+ appears in only one continuation, so its role in the mistake is uncertain.
The paired searches distinguish the two moves by only 15 centipawns.
Kh8 allows Qf8+ and a king chase where g4 attacks the exposed queen on h5. The fresh reply search reaches a queen exchange under the same pressure. Re8 gives a different defensive route.

limitations: One legal engine-assisted review, blind to classifier outputs, with uncertain mechanisms kept apart.
Broadcast game scores only select the loss and near-best strata. Fresh Stockfish paired and reply searches provide evidence.
The evidence addresses these 48 paired errors/controls from 24 distinct games and three untouched event sources.
